mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below its 3-year moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining GDPC1 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals accelerating supply-side activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of accelerating INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
